Our campaign comes to a close in Asia, with United running out winners in our final post-season contest.
Juninho had put the hosts ahead in the first half, before a brace from Chido Obi and a late header from Ayden Heaven means we end our 2024/25 campaign with a win.
A superb cross from Amad is met by Ayden Heaven, who scores our third of the afternoon.
Stefan's late effort is saved well by Altay Bayindir.
Tsang dives into a tackle on Patrick Dorgu and picks up a caution in the process.
Chido Obi rises the highest from Mason Mount's cross to put United ahead in Hong Kong.
